sentences.en: A bypass allows more blood to flow to the heart.
sentences.zh: 一个旁道可以让更多的血液流向心脏。

sentences.en: Fish ladders help salmon bypass man-made obstacles, such as dams.
sentences.zh: 鱼梯帮助鲑鱼绕过人工障碍物，比如水坝。

sentences.en: A vigilante bypasses the law and takes matters into his own hands.
sentences.zh: 这名义警违反法律，自行处理事情。

senses.zh: 旁道，支路；迂回管道；电分路迂徊
